questions.q: How many ordered \( 3 \)-tuples of integers \( (x_1, \dots, x_{3}) \) satisfy \( x_1 + \dots + x_{3} = 9 \) subject to \( x_i \ge 1 \) for every \( i = 1, \dots, 3 \)?
questions.answer: Shift variables by \( y_i = x_i - 1 \ge 0 \). Then \( y_1 + \dots + y_{3} = 9 - 3(1) = 6 \). By Stars and Bars, the number of non-negative integer solutions is \( \binom{6 + 3 - 1}{3 - 1} = \binom{8}{2} = 28 \).

questions.q: How many integers in \( \{1, 2, \dots, 180\} \) are divisible by at least one of \( 2,\; 3, \) or \( 5 \)?
questions.answer: By 3-set Inclusion-Exclusion, \( |A \cup B \cup C| = \lfloor 180/2 \rfloor + \lfloor 180/3 \rfloor + \lfloor 180/5 \rfloor - \lfloor 180/6 \rfloor - \lfloor 180/10 \rfloor - \lfloor 180/15 \rfloor + \lfloor 180/30 \rfloor = 132 \).

questions.q: Using Burnside's Orbit-Counting Lemma, how many rotationally distinct necklaces of \( 6 \) beads can be formed using up to \( 2 \) colors (where two necklaces are identical if one is a rotation of the other, without flipping)?
questions.answer: Under the cyclic rotation group \( C_{6} \), rotation by \( k \) steps decomposes into \( \gcd(6, k) \) cycles, fixing \( 2^{\gcd(6, k)} \) colorings. Grouping by \( d = \gcd(6, k) \mid 6 \) via Burnside's Lemma gives \( \frac{1}{6}\sum_{d \mid 6} \varphi(6/d)\cdot 2^d = \frac{84}{6} = 14 \).

questions.q: A convex \( 6 \)-gon has no three diagonals concurrent at an interior point. How many interior intersection points are formed by its diagonals?
questions.answer: Every \( 4 \)-element subset of the \( 6 \) vertices forms a unique convex quadrilateral whose two diagonals cross at a unique interior point. By this bijection, the number of interior diagonal intersections is \( \binom{6}{4} = 15 \).
